notes.title: Gaming Grid Editor Testing: START NOW!
notes.notes:
The focus testing for the Gaming Grid Editor is underway, and we invite you to dive in! In this playtest, you'll get hands-on experience with the Gaming Grid Editor, allowing you to create the scenes you envision or modify shared creations from fellow creators for gaming with your friends. Delve into the intricacies of the editor, and you can even customize game modes and logic components to make your game more engaging and vibrant.

While you can get a glimpse of our battle system and play with friends, this test is predominantly centered around the editor. Should you have any queries about how the editor operates, check our ongoing WIKI tutorial documents: [url=https://ggwiki.bgk-dev.com/index.php?title=Main_Page]Gaming Grid Wiki[/url], or give your feedback on the Steam forums or our official Discord server.

We've conducted extensive testing on the editor, but with the complexity involved, some issues may arise. Errors might occur in the game, and you could experience setbacks. We sincerely hope that won't be the case.

If you find yourself frustrated due to early testing issues, please don't hesitate to share your suggestions and opinions. Our team is committed to an open dialogue to grow GamingGrid together with you.

[b]Frequently Asked Questions:
[/b]
[b]What can the GamingGrid Editor do?
[/b]Our initial vision is to empower players to construct scenes like building blocks. We've set up some basic FPS game modes. Once your scene is built, a few steps are all it takes to swiftly begin "your game," and you can share your scenes on the Workshop, allowing others to modify them with your permission.

[b]Multiplayer Combat?
[/b]Currently, we have some gaps in gameplay, and our team is diligently working on it. Our focus for testing, however, is on the editor experience, so more new content won't be present in this test.

[b]Can I stream or make videos?
[/b]Absolutely. Just be aware that this is a test, and issues may arise.

[b]How to find people to play with?
[/b] During the testing phase, finding others to play with might be challenging, but you can invite your friends to experience your game, join our Discord channel shows in "JOIN COMMUNITY" or simply click on the "JOIN OUR DISCORD" banner.

Take your time to explore the game, and let us know your thoughts. We sincerely appreciate your attention.

Best wishes for a joyful gaming experience!
